title: PoE-Fuse: Precision-Weighted Expert Fusion for Bi-Temporal Change Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.37485v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bi-temporal change understanding, which localizes and characterizes what changed between two satellite images, is central to disaster response and environmental monitoring, spanning change detection, building localization, and damage assessment. Strong vision-language models address these tasks, but adapting them typically requires full fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, which is costly and unstable. We propose PoE-Fuse, a parameter-efficient framework that instead composes frozen foundation experts for geometry, grounding, and language, resampling their features onto a shared spatial grid and training only a lightweight fusion trunk. PoE-Fuse treats the aligned features as Gaussian observations of a latent scene state and fuses them by learned per-cell precision. This product-of-experts estimator strictly generalizes uniform summation and scalar gating, and extends to change fields by composing the precisions of the two timestamps

translated_title: PoE-Fuse：面向双时相变化理解的精度加权专家融合
translated_abstract: 双时相变化理解旨在定位并表征两幅卫星图像之间发生了什么变化，是灾害响应和环境监测的核心任务，涵盖变化检测、建筑物定位和损毁评估。强大的视觉-语言模型可以解决这些任务，但对其进行适配通常需要全量微调或强化学习，这既昂贵又不稳定。我们提出了PoE-Fuse，一个参数高效的框架，它通过组合面向几何、定位和语言的冻结基础模型专家，将其特征重采样到共享的空间网格上，并仅训练一个轻量级的融合主干。PoE-Fuse将对齐后的特征视为潜在场景状态的高斯观测，并通过学习到的逐单元精度对它们进行融合。这一专家乘积估计器严格推广了均匀求和与标量门控方法，并通过组合两个时间戳的精度进一步扩展到变化场。
tldr: PoE-Fuse提出了一种参数高效的框架，将对齐后的冻结基础模型专家特征视为高斯观测，通过学习到的逐单元精度进行专家乘积融合，仅需训练轻量级融合主干即可完成双时相变化理解任务，并严格推广了均匀求和与标量门控等传统融合方式。
en_tdlr: PoE-Fuse is a parameter-efficient framework that treats aligned features from frozen foundation experts as Gaussian observations and fuses them via learned per-cell precision using a product-of-experts estimator, requiring only a lightweight fusion trunk for bi-temporal change understanding.
